What We Haul

Dry van freight, done right

We run a 53-foot dry van on full-truckload general freight. If it ships dry, palletized, and floor- or dock-loaded, it is in our wheelhouse.

Palletized General Freight

Standard dry freight on pallets — the everyday loads that keep supply chains moving, handled like they are our own.

Apparel & Retail Freight

Clothing and retail goods are our regular work — including apparel freight for brands like Kontoor / Wrangler.

Full Truckload (FTL)

One shipper, one load, one truck. Your freight rides alone — never consolidated, never transferred between trucks.

Regional & OTR Lanes

Southeast regional runs plus longer over-the-road lanes through the Florida–Georgia–Arkansas–Oklahoma–Texas corridor.

Straight talk: dry van only. We don’t run reefer, flatbed, or hazmat — and we won’t book a load we can’t haul right. If your freight needs different equipment, we’ll tell you up front, not after pickup.

Where we run

Based in Lady Lake, Florida, running regional Southeast freight and over-the-road lanes, including:

  • Florida — home state; pickup and delivery statewide
  • Georgia — regular Southeast regional lanes
  • Arkansas & Oklahoma — OTR corridor runs
  • Texas — long-haul lanes through the corridor
  • Beyond the corridor — ask. If the lane and timing work, we’ll run it; if they don’t, we’ll say so.

Running a lane not listed here? Send the details with your quote request — the answer comes straight from the driver.

Why Owner-Operated

Your freight rides on one man’s name

Big fleets sell you capacity. A one-truck owner-operator sells you accountability — and there is nowhere for it to hide.

01

One Accountable Operator

The person who quotes your load, picks it up, and delivers it is the same person. If anything changes on the road, you hear it from the driver — not a call center.

02

Direct Communication

Email dispatch and the owner answers. Questions about timing, paperwork, or delivery get a straight answer from the cab, not a ticket in a queue.

03

Reputation Is the Business

For a one-truck company, every load is the whole reputation. Your freight gets treated the way a man treats his own name — because that is exactly what is on the door.

Booking a Load

Three steps, no phone tree

Send the lane

Use the quote form below or email dispatch with origin, destination, freight, weight, and dates.

Get a direct reply

The owner reviews the lane against his schedule and replies personally with a rate and timing — or an honest no.

Freight moves

Pickup, in-transit updates, and delivery confirmation come from the driver himself, start to finish. Freight moves under the operating carrier’s authority — that carrier’s authority and insurance documentation is available on request before booking.

About the Owner

The man you call is the man who drives

Road to Legacy Trucking is run by Sajacous Smith, an owner-operator out of Lady Lake, Florida. The company name is the mission: build something real, load by load, that outlasts a paycheck — a legacy built on doing freight the right way.

Today he runs 53′ dry van general freight across the Southeast and the Florida-to-Texas corridor, through his Florida company, SAJACOUS MIXED IT LLC (SunBiz Doc. L26000135400 — Active). When you book with Road to Legacy, there is no sales rep and no dispatcher between you and the truck. There is just the owner.
